adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new fallback for `updateEvent` (and similarly `deleteEvent`) is:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time this branch runs), the `find` predicate compares each `cal.externalId` to `externalCalendarId` (i.e., `undefined`), which will almost always return `undefined`. This destroys the previous fallback behavior of using the event’s stored destination calendar externalId. The same tautological `find(... === externalCalendarId)` appears in `deleteEvent`’s `calendarId` computation. This is a real correctness defect introduced by the diff because it prevents selecting the intended calendar when `externalCalendarId` isn’t provided.
